bio:
Physicist (Dr.rer. nat.) and Machine Learning Engineer with extensive experience in large-scale data analysis, scientific simulation, and automated workflow design.
I build robust ML and MLOps systems, design reproducible pipelines, and work comfortably with high-dimensional, fast-moving datasets. My focus is on translating complex analytical workflows into scalable, reliable services for real-time environments.
I bridge the gap between research prototypes and production systems, ensuring clarity, maintainability, and operational stability. Driven by analytical rigor and system thinking, I enjoy developing solutions that support data-driven decision-making in technically demanding domains.
Results snapshot:
- Built end-to-end ML workflows from ingestion to monitored inference.
- Delivered reproducibility through versioned data/model pipelines and containerized services.
- Applied modern MLOps tooling (Airflow, DVC, MLflow, Prometheus, Grafana) to improve traceability and reliability.
